text: Sight reading doesn't have to sound like a metronome in an empty room.
ABC sight reading turns any exercise into a play along video.
A real groove, a bouncing ball, and the next bar always waiting below.
Clap the rhythm over rock, soul, cumbia, or even trap.
Or sing it, your melody and your key with a band behind you.
Slow it down or speed it up.
Counting, kodai, or your own syllables, movable dough, fixed dough, or note names.
Put it on the board for the whole class or export it and share it.
Sight reading music can actually sound like, well, music.
ABC sight reading, practice real music.
